svg.title: Strawberry plant process and fruit-size comparison
svg.desc: Genetics LECT11b, authored slide 20. Stage A: rooted plantlet in a transparent culture vessel. Stage B: two outgoing arrows reach separate circles, both labelled 2n. Their connections join in C and continue downward to the larger rooted plant in D. At right, Normal fruit is smaller than Fruit of polyploid. Schematic artwork; fruit proportions are illustrative, not measured.
